title: Combine send and delegation actions in composer split button
outcome: Replace the separate reviewer/explorer delegation controls beside the session composer with a compact Send split-combobox. The primary action executes the selected mode, while the disclosure menu lets users choose Send, Delegate Reviewer, or Delegate Explorer. Preserve keyboard accessibility, disabled/busy semantics, agent capability restrictions, and existing delegation behavior.
acceptance: Composer exposes one right-aligned split Send control with selectable Send, Delegate Reviewer, and Delegate Explorer actions; the current selection is visible and executed by the primary button; Reviewer remains unavailable for unsupported agents; keyboard and screen-reader behavior is covered; existing send/delegation tests and the full UI quality gates pass.
